details.description: Grok 4.20 is a chat model from xAI, released in March 2026, part of the Grok 4.20 family alongside a Grok 4.20 Multi-agent model. On xAI's own documentation, the id "grok-4.20-0309" is listed as an alias that resolves to the reasoning-enabled model, grok-4.20-0309-reasoning, so it is the same underlying model with extended reasoning enabled by default. It accepts text and image input and produces text output, with a 1,000,000-token context window, and supports function calling, structured outputs and the Batch API.
advantages: Accepts both text and image input for text output, per xAI's model documentation.
Uses extended reasoning before responding, since it resolves to the same model as grok-4.20-0309-reasoning per xAI's alias listing.
Supports native function calling and structured outputs, per xAI's documentation.
disadvantages: xAI's documentation states that logprobs and top_logprobs are not supported by grok-4.20 and newer models.
use_cases: Agentic workflows that call tools/functions as part of multi-step tasks
Tasks that benefit from extended reasoning before answering
Vision tasks that combine image and text input

sources.title: grok-4.20-0309-reasoning - xAI docs (lists grok-4.20-0309 as an alias)

notes: "grok-4.20-0309" does not appear as its own row in xAI's models/pricing table; its dedicated docs page and the alias list on the grok-4.20-0309-reasoning page both show it as an alias of grok-4.20-0309-reasoning, so this entry describes that model. Marketing superlatives from xAI's page ('lowest hallucination rate on the market') are omitted since no benchmark backs them. No evaluation scores were found.
